summary: Miami (OH) is a 3.5-point road favorite after the line flipped from CMU favored at open, and CMU's offense scores 16.6 a game. Most likely to win: Miami (OH) ML (-166).

extra_legs.note: M-OH scores 26.9 a game against a CMU offense that throws for only 108 yards.
M-OH has won 4 of 7 and beat Akron 34-14 while CMU scored 14 or fewer in three of five.
M-OH allows 277 pass yards and scores 27, and the total sits below both teams' combined average.

totals_projection: M-OH 26.9 ppg vs CMU allowing 25.6 -> ~26.2; CMU 16.6 ppg vs M-OH allowing 25.6 -> ~21.1. Raw 47, discounted for CMU's slow run-heavy pace to about 43 vs 40.5, lean Over.
research:
1. Home field: Kelly/Shorts Stadium, Mount Pleasant, 1 PM, 58F, 10 mph gusts, 0% precip (ESPN/AccuWeather). Small wind effect.
2. Records: Miami (OH) 4-3 (2-1 MAC), CMU 3-4 (1-2 MAC).
3. Miami offense 26.9 ppg, 358 yds (216 pass, 141 rush); defense 25.6 ppg, 376 yds, 277 pass yds allowed but only 99 rush yds. QB David McComb 65/103 (63%), 1,121 yds, 7 TD, 1 INT. RB Rodney Nelson 348 yds, WR Maleek Huggins 309.
4. CMU offense 16.6 ppg, 292 yds (108 pass, 184 rush); defense 25.6 ppg, 359 yds. QB Angel Flores 54/92, 475 yds, 2 TD, 2 INT and a team-high 618 rush yds on 128 carries. WR Langston Lewis 216 yds.
5. Scheme: CMU is a QB-run option offense that shortens the game; Miami's run defense (99 yds) takes away that core, while CMU's pass offense is thin.
6. M-OH last five: W 34-14 Akron, W 20-19 at UMass, L 20-24 BGSU, W 24-21 UConn, L 31-35 at Cincinnati. Close games throughout.
7. CMU last five: L 14-21 WMU, L 14-31 at Ohio, W 41-17 Akron, L 3-52 at Miami (FL), W 24-10 Wyoming.
8. Market (DraftKings via ESPN): M-OH -3.5 (-110/-110), ML M-OH -166 / CMU +140, total 40.5 (o-105, u-115). ESPN shows CMU was the home favorite at open, so the line moved to Miami.
9. ESPN matchup predictor: M-OH 56.4%, CMU 43.6%, below the no-vig ML of 60%.
10. Injuries: ESPN lists none; no backup QB information found.
11. Analysts: no named 2026 picks found; consensus not claimed.
12. Read: M-OH has the better QB and balanced offense; ML is the safest, spread is the fair price.
